Department: Product

About the Role

As the Senior Product Manager for Verified Audience, you will own one of Prove's newest product lines, from early revenue to scale. Verified Audience lets lenders and merchants recognize a real, verified consumer the moment they arrive on a website, without asking them to log in or fill out a form, and make them a personalized offer in real time. The first use case is firm offers of credit: a consumer browsing a credit card page sees that they are pre-approved, instead of a generic "Apply now" button.

The product sits where identity, credit and marketing meet. It is delivered with a major credit bureau partner and is bought from customers' marketing and acquisition budgets rather than their fraud or identity budgets. You will define the roadmap, run the product side of our partnerships, and prove to customers that the product drives measurable conversion lift.

You will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Business Development, Sales and Marketing, and with Prove's executive team, since Verified Audience is a company-level priority.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the Verified Audience strategy, roadmap and requirements end to end, from matching an anonymous visitor to a verified identity through to the real-time offer the consumer sees.

• Run the product side of our credit bureau partnership and other data and channel partners, including joint requirements, integration plans, launch readiness and performance reviews.

• Move early customers from beta to production, and define the metrics that show the product's value, such as pre-approval rate, conversion lift and revenue per verified visitor.

• Set pricing and packaging with Finance and Sales for a product sold into marketing and acquisition budgets.

• Expand the product beyond credit cards into personal lending, buy now pay later and merchant financing, and evaluate adjacent channels such as programmatic audiences and identity graph partners.

• Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy and Information Security so the product meets FCRA, GLBA, mobile carrier and consumer privacy requirements.

• Create the product documentation that doesn't exist yet: architecture, data flows, partner and carrier approval requirements, and customer-facing integration guides.

• Work with Engineering and Data Science to manage the backlog, write clear requirements, and deliver on time.

• Communicate strategy and progress to executives, and set realistic expectations with internal stakeholders and partners.

Qualifications and Experience

• 6+ years of product management, including at least 2 years owning a B2B or B2B2C product from launch to revenue.

• Experience with consumer credit, card acquisition, lending, or marketing and growth products sold into marketing budgets.

• Track record leading complex partner integrations (credit bureaus, data providers, mobile carriers or payment networks) with engineering, legal and business development teams.

• Strong data skills, including SQL and funnel and conversion analysis, and comfort presenting results to customers.

• Experience taking a new product from 0 to 1 in a fast-moving, high-growth company.

• Solid technical understanding of APIs, data matching and real-time decisioning systems.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to build consensus across functions and with senior leaders.

• Promotes Prove's values of humility, passion, inclusion and leadership.

Nice to Have

• Experience at or with a credit bureau (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion), or with prescreen and firm-offer-of-credit programs.

• Working knowledge of FCRA, GLBA and consumer data privacy rules.

• Background in payments, identity, authentication, or mobile and telco data.

• Experience in ad-tech or mar-tech, such as programmatic audiences, demand-side platforms or identity resolution.

• Early customers are live in production, with conversion lift measured and reported.

• A 2027 roadmap and go-to-market plan is agreed with leadership, starting with card acquisition and laying out the path to lending and buy now pay later.

• Own a largely greenfield product line with a live credit bureau partnership and early revenue already in place.

• Work on a company-level priority with direct access to Prove's executive team.

• A clear path to Lead or Principal PM as the product expands into new use cases.
